text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: A giant monster appeared right before the resort was about to open, his name Sharkskin Fangmurai. He suddenly confessed to Louise Marie, but as expected...
text_block_list.orig_text:
リゾートに現れた巨大な魔物・『鮫肌牙之丞』。
突然ルイズマリーに告白したのだが、
果たして──

text_block_list.name: Sharkskin Fangmurai
text_block_list.text: Louise Marie... Court me. With marriage as the end goal...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ルイズマリー。
交際するぞ。
結婚を前提に……！

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: I ABSOLUTELY REFUSE!!!
text_block_list.orig_text: お断りよ！！！

text_block_list.name: Sharkskin Fangmurai
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? I didn't quite catch that--...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ん？
　よく聞こえなかったが──

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: I already said it, don't make me repeat myself... I RE-FU-S~
text_block_list.orig_text:
だから言ってるでしょ！！
　
お・
こ・
と・
わ──

text_block_list.name: Ghost Couple
text_block_list.text: DON'T!" "YOU CAN'T!
text_block_list.orig_text:
「駄目だ！」
「駄目よ！」

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: EHHH?! The ghost couple from the cage!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええっ！？
あなたたちは
洞窟のカップル幽霊！？

text_block_list.name: Ghost Darling
text_block_list.text: That thing is the sovereign of these waters... forever yearning for love, forever suffering for love... If you anger him, it'll be a disaster...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あいつは恋に恋い焦がれ
恋に泣くこの辺りの主……
あいつを怒らせては
とんでもないことに……っ。

text_block_list.name: Ghost Honey
text_block_list.text: ...He fell in love with me at first sight. But when he found out I had a lover, he went on a rampage... and sank half of this island into the sea...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……私、
あいつに一目惚れされたんです。
でも恋人がいるって知ったら大暴れして……
この島の半分を
海に沈めたんです……っ！！

text_block_list.name: Creditta
text_block_list.text: WHA-... Is it really such a dangerous monster?! ...Hey, Louise Marie-san. Just say yes! Lie if you have to! We'll make something up and send him home...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
んなっ……
そんなヤバい魔物ですのっ！？
……
ちょ、
ルイズマリーさん。
ここはウソでもいいからOKしなさいな！
適当ぶっこいて
ひとまず魔物に帰ってもらいましょう……っ！

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: I already have someone I love! I couldn't possibly date you!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
私には愛する人がいるの！！
あなたとは交際できないから！！

text_block_list.name: Creditta
text_block_list.text: SO BRIGHT!!! ARE YOU A FOOL?!?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
まぶしっ！！！
バカなのかしら！？！？

text_block_list.name: Sharkskin Fangmurai
text_block_list.text: ...Oh? So you reject my love. My confession! ...Because you have someone else you love...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ほう。
断るというのか、
この俺の愛情を。
告白をっ！
……他に
愛する人がいるから……
と。

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: That's right! My own fated, DESTINED prince whose compatibility with me exceeds even 300%...! *glance*
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうよ！
相性300％の
運命の王子さまがね……っ！
（ちらっ）

text_block_list.name: Sharkskin Fangmurai
text_block_list.text: Oh? That thoroughly unremarkable fellow? Hmph. Don't insult destiny.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほう……
そんな冴えない男と？
フッ、
冗談にもならん。

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: Unremarkable...!? Hmph! So it's true sharks have terrible eyesight! If you can't see how amazing Darling is, you're blinder than I thought!
text_block_list.orig_text:
冴えない男……？
フンッ！
　
鮫は視力が悪いってのは本当なのね！
ダーリンのカッコよさが分からないなんて、
とんだフシ穴だわ！

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: {0}-kun is my absolute, one and only, SOULMATE!
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}くんは正真正銘、
私の運命のひとなんだから！

text_block_list.name: Sharkskin Fangmurai
text_block_list.text: In that case, prove it. Go on. Kiss. Kiss. Kiss.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ならば証明してみろ。
ほら、
キース、
キース、
キース。

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: I-I can't do that right now...!! ...Um, well...! The Forbidden Elixir's effect is still working...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……そ、
それはできないわ……っ！！
……
その、
あれよ……！
秘薬の効果がまだ残ってるからっ……！

text_block_list.name: Sharkskin Fangmurai
text_block_list.text: The "Forbidden Elixir's effect"...? I don't really understand... Well then. I ask you this question.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……秘薬の効果？
よく分からんが……
それでは。
貴様に問おう。

text_block_list.name: Sharkskin Fangmurai
text_block_list.text: Hey, unremarkable man. Are you really Louise Marie's soulmate?
text_block_list.orig_text:
おい、
冴えない男。
貴様は本当に、
ルイズマリーの伴侶なのか？

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: {0}-kun...! You don't have to answer that creature...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}くん……！
答えなくていいわよ、
あんな奴の言う事……！

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: ...I can't ask. ...I don't want to.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……聞けない。
……聞きたくない。

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: Because... what if I'm the only one getting carried away talking about being soulmates...? I'm too scared... to ask how Darling really feels...
text_block_list.orig_text:
だって……
伴侶だなんて舞い上がってるのが
もしも私だけだったらって思うと……
ダーリンの気持ちなんて……
怖くて聞けない……

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: OKAY!! THAT'LL BE IT FOR TODAY!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
は
いっ！
今日はここまでっ！！

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: Whether it's the words I want to hear... or not. Now's not the time to hear them...
text_block_list.orig_text:
私の欲しい言葉でも……
そうじゃない言葉でも。
聞くのは今じゃない……

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: Because I'm not treating this like some reckless, spur-of-the-moment romance.
text_block_list.orig_text:
勢い任せでいい恋愛なんて……
してないからっ。

text_block_list.name: Creditta
text_block_list.text: ...She really does wear her heart on her sleeve. Such embarrassingly youthful romance... Not that I envy it or anything. Still... it's awfully dazzling.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……本当にわかりやすい子ですわ。
青臭い恋愛ね……
うらやむわけじゃありませんけど
まったく、
眩しいものですわね。

text_block_list.name: Creditta
text_block_list.text: Well, enjoy it while you can. Once those years pass... no amount of money in the world will ever buy you a chance to experience a love like that again.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ま、
謳歌するがよし、
ですわ。
年月を経てしまえば、
たとえ何億ルピを積もうが
経験できない恋になるのですから。

text_block_list.name: Ghost Darling
text_block_list.text: Um... could you listen for a second?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あの、
ちょっといいですか？

text_block_list.name: Ghost Honey
text_block_list.text: If you were planning to drive him away, there's something we can tell you... a weakness of his...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
もしもあいつを追い払ってくれるのなら
伝えたくて。
……
あいつの弱点を……！

text_block_list.name: Creditta
text_block_list.text: A weakness...!?

text_block_list.name: Creditta
text_block_list.text: ...I see. So that's his weakness. But in order to take advantage of it...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……なるほど、
それがやつの弱点ですのね。
ですがその弱点を突くためには……

text_block_list.name: Creditta
text_block_list.text: Hmm... I simulated hundreds of patterns in my head, but this is the best option... I thought I'd never have to go through this again, but... I guess I have no choice, I'll have to brace myself...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
フム……
数百ものパターンを脳内シミュレーションしてみましたが、
これがベストオプション……
もう二度とごめんだと思っておりましたが、
仕方ありませんわね、
覚悟を決めて……っ！！

text_block_list.name: Creditta
text_block_list.text: Glug!!
text_block_list.orig_text: んぐっ！！

text_block_list.name: Sharkskin Fangmurai
text_block_list.text: What are you doing? Hurry up and prove it. Kiss. Kiss. Kis-...
text_block_list.orig_text:
何をしている、
早く証明してみせろ。
それ、
キース、
キース、
キー……

text_block_list.name: Creditta
text_block_list.text: I'VE GOTTEN BIGGEEEEER!!!
text_block_list.orig_text: 巨大化ですわぁぁぁーっ！！！

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie & Sharkskin Fangmurai
text_block_list.text: EEEEHHHHHHH?!!
text_block_list.orig_name: ルイズマリー・鮫肌牙之丞
text_block_list.orig_text: えええええっ！！？

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: Wha... Creditta-san!? You used the "Forbidden Elixir of Giant Growth" on yourself... but for what purpose!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょ、
クレジッタさんっ！？
自分で巨大化の薬を……
って
なんのために！？

text_block_list.name: Creditta
text_block_list.text: It's all for the sake of hitting his weakness!! Well then, here I go!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こいつの弱点を突くためですわっ！！
それじゃあいきますわよ～っ！！

text_block_list.name: Creditta
text_block_list.text: DOOOORYAAAAAAH!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
どぉぉりゃああ～
～～っ！！！

text_block_list.name: Creditta
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I heard everything about your WEAKNESS! That is... your CHEEK!! No doubt about it, is there?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
フフッ、
聞きましたわよ、
あなたの弱点！
それは頬！！
間違いないんですわよね！？

text_block_list.name: Ghost Darling
text_block_list.text: Yeah... No matter how much I tried to cut and slash him, there was no scratch on his shark skin. However...! Just one slap from my Honey did a lot of damage...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ……
俺がいくら切っても突いても
傷一つつかなかった鮫肌。
だけど
ハニーが放った頬へのビンタ一撃で
大ダメージを……！

text_block_list.name: Creditta
text_block_list.text: And that's that! Now begone! Sharkskin Fangmurai!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
という訳ですわ！
さあ、
去りなさい！
　鮫肌牙之丞！！

text_block_list.name: Sharkskin Fangmurai
text_block_list.text: Did you just do something?
text_block_list.orig_text: なにかしたか？

text_block_list.name: Creditta
text_block_list.text: WHA!? H-He didn't even flinch...!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なっ！？
　ビ、
ビクとも……っ！？

text_block_list.name: Ghost Honey
text_block_list.text: N-No way...! This is impossible...! I'm certain he fainted from my slap...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ……
そんな、
嘘じゃありません……！
確かに私のビンタで気絶しちゃったのに……！

text_block_list.name: Sharkskin Fangmurai
text_block_list.text: Heh... YOUR slap worked. A slap from the woman you love hurts more than anything else.
text_block_list.orig_text:
フッ……
あのビンタは効いた。
惚れた女のビンタは
なにより
痛い。

text_block_list.name: Sharkskin Fangmurai
text_block_list.text: Apologies, exhibitionist tanuki-like woman. My shark skin doesn't react to you. To put it bluntly, you're not my type.
text_block_list.orig_text:
すまないが、
タヌキの露出女よ。
貴様に、
我が鮫肌は反応しない。
端的に言えば、
タイプじゃない。

text_block_list.name: Creditta
text_block_list.text: ...Huuuuh?

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: Kh... It's tough being such a popular girl...! Huh? HYAAAAH?
text_block_list.orig_text:
くっ……
モテる女は辛いわ……っ！
──えっ？
　
ひゃあっ？

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: Wha-... Creditta-san?! Picking me up like this... What are you doing?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっ、
クレジッタさん！？
私を摘まみ上げて……
なにをっ！？

text_block_list.name: Creditta
text_block_list.text: Yes yes yes yes, sorry for not being your type!!! I wonder what would happen if this girl slapped you~~~!!! Aaaaah! I mean, who the hell is a exhibitionist tanuki-like woman? I'LL NEVER FORGIVE YOU!!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はいはいはいはいタイプじゃなくて悪うございましたねっ！！！
それならこの子のビンタだったらどうなのかしらねぇ～～～っ！！！
はああ～ってか誰がタヌキの露出女ですの
ったく許しませんわぁぁ！！

text_block_list.name: Creditta
text_block_list.text: BE PREPARED, LOUISE MARIE-SAN!! DOOOOOOOOORYAAAAAAAAAAAH!!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
かましてらっしゃいルイズマリーさんっ！！
どぉぉりゃああぁぁぁ～
～～っ！！！

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: GYAAAAAAAAAAH!!!
text_block_list.orig_text: ぎゃああぁぁっ！！！

text_block_list.name: Sharkskin Fangmurai
text_block_list.text: Heh. A sudden dive straight into a kiss? What a bold woman! Right, I'll be ready to accept it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
フッ、
いきなりダイビングからの接吻とは大胆な女め。
よし、
受け止めてやる。

text_block_list.name: Sharkskin Fangmurai
text_block_list.text: *smoooch!*
text_block_list.orig_text: むちゅ～～～～っ♡

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: YOU'RE DISGUSTING!!!
text_block_list.orig_text: 気持ち悪いっっ！！

text_block_list.name: Creditta
text_block_list.text: All right, a CLEAN HIT! Nice one, Loui--...
text_block_list.orig_text:
よっしゃあクリーンヒットォ！！
ナイスですわよルイ……

text_block_list.name: Creditta
text_block_list.text: Wait... WAIT, WAIT, WAIT!!? The "Forbidden Elixir's" still working... Which means...
text_block_list.orig_text:
って待って待って待って待ってっ！！？
まだ秘薬の効果は残って……
ってことは……

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie & Creditta
text_block_list.text: A... Massive... Explosion...
text_block_list.orig_name: ルイズマリー・クレジッタ
text_block_list.orig_text:
大・
爆・
発──

text_block_list.name: Sharkskin Fangmurai
text_block_list.text: GUOOOOOOOOOHHHHHHHHH!!?
text_block_list.orig_text: ぐおおおおおっ！！？

text_block_list.name: Creditta
text_block_list.text: That Sharkskin guy turned into a supernova... No, more importantly!
text_block_list.orig_text:
鮫肌が星に……
いえ、
それより！

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: KYAAAAHHHHHHH!!!
text_block_list.orig_text: きゃああああっ！！

text_block_list.name: Creditta
text_block_list.text: LOUISE MARIE-SAN!!!
text_block_list.orig_text: ルイズマリーさんっ！！

text_block_list.name: Creditta
text_block_list.text: ...! She was blown into the sky because of the resulting blast, wasn't she!? At this rate, she'll end up on the other side of the island...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……っ。
爆風に煽られて空に飛ばされましたわねっ！？
このままでは島の反対側まで行ってしまいます……！！

text_block_list.name: Creditta
text_block_list.text: ...Don't worry, with my current stride, I'll make it! I'll definitely save you!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……大丈夫、
今のわたくしの歩幅なら間に合う！
必ず助けますわ！！

text_block_list.name: Creditta
text_block_list.text: No, if you were to touch her while still under the effect of that "Forbidden Elixir"... But this is no time for discussions! Let's go!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いえ、
しかしあなたは秘薬の効果で触れると……
なんて言ってる場合じゃありませんわね。
行きますわよ！！

text_block_list.name: Secretary
text_block_list.text: LADY CREDITTA! LOUISE MARIE-SAN IS FALLING RIGHT THERE!
text_block_list.orig_text:
クレジッタさま！！
ルイズマリーさんが落下してきますっ！！

text_block_list.name: Creditta
text_block_list.text: It's all right... By staying calm, this will all be solved without issue... Don't you know I have confidence in my catching ability?
text_block_list.orig_text:
大丈夫……
落ち着けば問題ない……
わたくし捕球には自信がありますか──

text_block_list.name: Creditta
text_block_list.text: RAAAAAAHHHHH!? Ugh...
text_block_list.orig_text: らあああああぁっ！？

text_block_list.name: Secretary
text_block_list.text: Wha... Is this the time to be tripping on a rock...!? LADY CREDITTA...!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
な……
岩につまずいて……！？
クレジッタさま……！！

text_block_list.name: Creditta
text_block_list.text: Guh... I have to get up quickly...!! I have to hurry... and help Louise Marie-san...!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぐっ……
早く立ち上がらなければ……っ！！
早く……
ルイズマリーさんを……っ！！

text_block_list.name: Creditta
text_block_list.orig_text: 少年……っ！！

text_block_list.name: Secretary
text_block_list.text: KNIGHT-SAN!! According to Louise Marie-san's hourglass... there's only 10 seconds left until the effects of the Forbidden Elixir wear off!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士さん！
！
ルイズマリーさんの『砂時計』によれば……
秘薬の効果が切れるまで、
あと10秒です！！！

text_block_list.name: Creditta
text_block_list.text: 9 seconds... 8 seconds...!! They can't touch each other until then...!! Aaaah, what's going to happen!!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
９秒……
８秒……！！
それまであなたは触れられません……っ！！
あああっ、
どうなりますのっ！！？
